definitions.BUS: Business activity; does not replace an excluded multinational-corporation affiliation code.
definitions.COP: Police officers, policing units and protective agencies.
definitions.CRM: Criminal activity principally for profit or personal gratification, distinct from armed political opposition.
definitions.CVL: Positively evidenced civilian capacity when no more specific role applies; do not default every unidentified person to CVL.
definitions.ELI: Former government officials and other evidenced elite status; a former title alone does not establish current GOV.
definitions.GOV: Executive and government administration; the manual also includes governing parties. Project rule: party membership alone does not establish a person holding executive office; record PTY instead.
definitions.HLH: Health or social-welfare activity or specialty.
definitions.IGO: International or regional inter-governmental organization. For a person, assign IGO only for an explicitly evidenced office, employment, appointment or representative capacity in such an organization, including the United Nations; attendance at its meeting alone is insufficient.
definitions.INS: Armed political opposition seeking to overthrow the national government.
definitions.INT: An evidenced international actor that cannot be further specified by the evidence as an international organization/movement/company or state actor. Not a blanket replacement for excluded categories.
definitions.LEG: Legislative membership or office. Project adopts the manual's legislature-specific coding option.
definitions.MIL: State military personnel and forces; requires evidenced state affiliation.
definitions.OPP: Political opposition or anti-government political activity; does not imply violence.
definitions.PTY: Membership in a political party; alone does not establish executive or legislative office.
definitions.REB: Armed political opposition with unspecified or limited aims; prefer INS or SEP when their specific aims are evidenced.
definitions.SEP: Armed political opposition seeking separation of a region from its country.
definitions.UAF: Evidenced armed forces with unclear state/rebel alignment or neither alignment; not a generic unknown-person code.
definitions.UIS: An evidenced state actor acting for a state whose identity is not supplied. The person may be named; the state is unidentified.

international_excluded: all organization-specific composite codes including IGOUNO
rules: Code the evidenced capacity of this person, not nearby people or institutions. Attendance at an organization meeting does not establish affiliation.

An evidenced United Nations or other inter-governmental organization appointment can receive IGO. Known NGO, international movement, international militarized group or multinational-company affiliations remain OUTSIDE_SCOPE for international coding, not automatically INT. Preserve the literal affiliation. Organization-specific composite codes, including IGOUNO, are not outputs.
Return compatible role_codes and specialty_codes separately. A health minister has GOV role with HLH specialty, not independent Government and Others roles.
A specialty can itself be a role when it describes the standalone evidenced capacity (e.g. a journalist MED).
For an explicitly former government official, ELI describes the current former-official observation. A separate dated past-tenure claim can receive GOV for its historical interval.
Code each claim at its stated temporal scope. Python, not the model, checks whether that scope covers each report-date target.
Opposition is not necessarily armed. Do not infer overthrow or secession goals from generic rebel membership.
Do not output UNK as a CAMEO code; unsupported claims use INSUFFICIENT and empty arrays.
